## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New method / estimator (must cite a published reference)
- [ ] Refactor (no behaviour change)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI / build / tooling
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing behaviour to change)

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally: `python -m pytest`
- [ ] Lint clean: `ruff check src tests`
- [ ] New/changed **methods are validated against synthetic data with a
      known ground truth** (recovery, coverage, or size test).
- [ ] **No real personal data**: no names, platform IDs, account info,
      private datasets, or personal absolute paths are introduced.
- [ ] Results are computed from data — **no hard-coded or cached values**
      presented as estimates.
- [ ] Documentation updated (README / docs/ / docstrings) where relevant.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes.
